cross_source.detector_click_offset_note: H_rig - implied. Positive = the detector's click point sits above the ground contact. Calibrated on the GSV runs against the depth-measured modern rig, then transferred; it is NOT identifiable from bearings alone.

depth_anchor.interpretation: Both columns are H_rig - delta for the SAME detection pixels, so the detector's click offset cancels: the gap is a disagreement between the two measurement systems, not a convention difference.

meta.does_not_use: vertical click angle, camera height, ground-plane assumption, depth data, panorama resolution
meta.estimator: leave-one-out least-squares intersection of bearing rays
meta.uses: panorama positions, panorama headings, horizontal detection angle

camera_tilt_hypothesis.verdict: tilt does NOT explain it: every sign convention leaves the depression trend larger than the uncorrected data, so the recorded pose is adding noise rather than removing a systematic
